text:
Rhea: Who swiped the lemon cake from the top shelf? Found only crumbs and a guilty smear. :lemon: :cry: 
Jon: Not me. I saw a sticky note that said "claim if hungry" and then no name. :shrug: 
Diego: I may have admired it from afar. Was it the tray with blue icing? 
Rhea: Yes! Blue icing + little lemon zest on top. It was labeled 'Team Thank You' but no owner. 
Priya: Oof. Could we do a small rule: anything on top shelf older than 48h is fair game unless tagged with a name and team? 
pantry-bot: FYI: /pantry-expiry will list items older than 48 hours. Use /pantry-tag <item> <name> to tag personal items. 
Jon: Love that. Also propose "Fridge Police" rota. 1 person a week to clear mystery food and reorder staples. 10 minutes. 
Diego: I can take on Fridge Police for this week. Will bring replacement tea bags as a peace offering. 
Rhea: Diego the noble. Thank you. Please also label the cake grave with a tiny sign: "Do not feed to the plant." :seedling: 
Priya: Poll: weekend pastry choices for next office treat. Reply with 1/2/3.
1) Scones
2) Blueberry muffins
3) Fruit box (no guilt)

Rhea: 2
Jon: 3
Diego: 2
Priya: 3 - split the difference?
Rhea: Looks like 2 and 3 tie. Maybe we do half boxes each? 
Jon: Also reminder: if you're bringing in a full box, drop a quick post in #kitchen so others don't show up with forks. 
Diego: Noted. I'll bring tea + a small pack of muffins Friday AM. 
pantry-bot: Reminder scheduled: Auto-reorder oat milk on Friday at 9am if count < 2. Use /pantry-set-autoreorder to adjust. 
Rhea: Thanks everyone. Small ask: can we put a jar labeled "coffee cash" and a tiny envelope for exact change? Saves excuses. 
Priya: I'll make the jar today and leave it by the kettle. 
Jon: Moral of the thread: label your stuff or risk becoming office legend. :trophy: 
Rhea: Closing thread. Fridge Police Diego reporting for duty. 
Diego: Happy to serve. May the plants be fed with dignity. :herb:
